run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 swept across all nine jurisdictions via web search (AusTender, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA/SA/TAS, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders). Tier 2 sampled: WA Primary Health Alliance (WAPHA/PHN commissioning), universities (UTS eTendering, UOW), local government via VendorPanel and council sites, GBEs/utilities (Sydney Water, Transgrid, NBN Co) and NSW Health/HealthShare procurement. Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing checked (SAP Business Network / Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Coupa) - all registration- or login-gated with no publicly-advertised RFx visible this run, so only portals were recorded and no corporate tenders were fabricated. Five genuinely-new, currently-open opportunities were captured this run (two WAPHA RFQs, a UTS EOI and two buy.nsw EOIs); several other strong open opportunities matched dedup keys from prior runs and were not re-listed to preserve first_seen semantics. As on prior runs, the egress proxy blocked every WebFetch call, so all detail is WebSearch-snippet-derived - no tender detail pages or specification documents could be opened, and every captured tender still needs an authenticated/unblocked detail pass.
gaps: WebFetch was egress-blocked for every domain tested this run (www.tenders.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED). All opportunity detail is therefore WebSearch-snippet-derived; every captured tender still needs an authenticated/unblocked pass to read the notice detail page, specification documents, evaluation criteria, exact closing time/timezone and contacts.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Business Network Discovery (Ariba Discovery), BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Coupa, Qantas and the major banks were checked; their live RFx are registration- or login-gated and no publicly-advertised corporate tender surfaced this run. Portals recorded in discovered_sources only; no corporate opportunities invented. Management-consultancy and panel RFPs remain invitation-only and out of scope.

A 'Large-scale Solar PV Project - John Hunter Hospital' EOI (Hunter New England LHD / NSW Health) surfaced only via an aggregator listing (australiantenders.com.au id 403067). Its live status and closing date could not be confirmed against a buyer-originated source (WebFetch blocked; search results conflated it with a completed 2021 rooftop-solar system), so it was NOT captured as a tender - flagged here as a signal to verify next run.

NT Quotations & Tenders Online (QTOL) and ACT Tenders returned no concrete new open opportunity via search this run (search surfaced only portal/landing pages); coverage deferred to a future run with a working detail fetch.

Several strong currently-open opportunities were already captured in prior daily runs and matched existing dedup keys, so they were not re-listed to preserve first_seen semantics: UOW ServiceNow Panel EOI and ServiceNow Support Partner EOI, buy.nsw Swansea Bridge BN1365 steel components, buy.nsw Fire System Maintenance - Northern & Coffs Harbour Tunnels, AusTender ASCA-RFT-2026-LDTPM (ASCA Power Challenge). Two ASCA notices seen in search (ASCA Mission T-S RFT, ASCA EDT P2ISR RFP) are already CLOSED (closed 30-May-2025 and 18-May-2026 respectively) and were excluded.
recommended_seed_additions: State Library of NSW (procurement/FM) - publishes recurring facilities/cleaning EOIs via buy.nsw; add as a tracked gov-state buyer.
WA Primary Health Alliance (WAPHA) tender page https://www.wapha.org.au/tender/ - active PHN commissioning RFQ/RFI pipeline (multiple RFQs open concurrently); worth weekly checks.
